goal: Prevent peer message handling from stalling when reconsidering orphan transactions
Reduces network message latency across peers during orphan transaction processing
agreement: Suggested adding a unit or fuzz test to cap reconsidered items per step (instagibbs)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because uninterruptible orphan processing poses a CPU denial of service hazard across peers
More granular processing keeps peer message loops responsive and improves network robustness
